# anecdotes_evidences (Data Source)

Lists all evidences in the Anecdotes account, with optional filtering by service, name, type, or applicability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_evidences" "all" {}

data "anecdotes_evidences" "aws" {
  service_id = "aws_guard_duty"
}

output "evidence_count" {
  value = data.anecdotes_evidences.all.total_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `evidence_type` (String) Filter evidences by type. Valid values (matched case-insensitively): "MANUAL", "URL", "LINK", "LIST", "TICKET", "BUILDER", "API", "MERGED".
- `include_views` (Boolean) Include evidence views (filtered subsets of parent evidence) in the results. By default, only parent evidences are returned. Set to true to also include views.
- `is_applicable` (Boolean) Filter evidences by applicability status.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Filter evidences by custom (user-created) status.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter evidences whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).
- `service_id` (String) Filter evidences by service/plugin ID (e.g., "aws_guard_duty", "github").

### Read-Only

- `evidences` (Attributes List) List of evidences matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evidences))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of evidences matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--evidences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evidences`

Read-Only:

- `alert_level` (Number) The alert level of the evidence (0-5).
- `collection_timestamp` (String) When the evidence was last collected.
- `creation_time` (String) When the evidence was created.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the evidence.
- `entity_type` (String) The entity type of the evidence.
- `evidence_id` (String) The unique identifier of the evidence.
- `evidence_instance_id` (String) The instance identifier of the evidence.
- `evidence_type` (String) The type of evidence (MANUAL, URL, LINK, LIST, TICKET, BUILDER, API, MERGED).
- `is_applicable` (Boolean) Whether the evidence is applicable.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Whether the evidence is custom (user-created).
- `is_uar` (Boolean) Whether the evidence is a user access review.
- `items_count` (Number) Number of items/rows in the evidence.
- `name` (String) The internal name of the evidence.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent evidence ID.
- `processing_state` (String) The processing state of the evidence (e.g., "success_data_exists").
- `service_display_name` (String) The display name of the service/plugin.
- `service_id` (String) The service/plugin ID that provides this evidence.
- `url` (String) The URL of the evidence, if applicable.
